author: Sai
install_msg: Thanks for installing LifeSim. Start with `[p]lifesim help` and configure jobs, food, and houses from Discord.
name: LifeSim
short: Life simulation game with Red bank credits
description: A Red Discord bot cog that simulates a small life economy with jobs, food, housing, needs, upkeep, and configurable guild settings.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-guild life simulation settings (jobs, foods, houses, and tuning values) and per-member life state (job, house, needs, inventory, XP, and timestamps). It does not store real-world personal data.
